decision: Determine whether native boundary-spline values, normal derivatives, and tractions retain a decisive accuracy or state-size advantage over an hp-optimized continuous GLL spectral-element reconstruction.
information_boundary: Comparative errors and rankings are excluded from this immutable specification.

spline.evaluation: native tensor-product basis and analytic basis derivatives
spline.route_label_rule: Report BMF6 and BMG6 together only when their static off-grid reconstruction and same-point derivative objects are identical.

spectral_element.element_count_rule: For each state cap N and degree P, admit every integer K >= 1 satisfying K*P+1 <= N.
spectral_element.evaluation: native element-local barycentric values and derivatives

common_data.fields: identical analytic u, v, p samples for every entrant
common_data.normals: identical archived analytic outward unit normals
common_data.state_accounting: one-dimensional state size n, with tensor state size 3*n^2 for u, v, p

aggregation_grain: each surface, state budget, entrant, and metric across all 12 fields and 48 markers

costs.state_size: one-dimensional n and tensor scalar count 3*n^2
costs.memory: persistent sampled-state bytes, reconstruction bytes, and precomputed evaluation-plan bytes
costs.setup: single-thread process time to prepare reconstruction coefficients from sampled state, excluding common analytic sampling
costs.recurring_evaluation: single-thread process time for native values and first derivatives of u, v, p at all 48 markers

promotion.traction_dominance: At each declared surface and budget, spline traction median, p95, and worst error must all be strictly below the optimized spectral-element envelope.
promotion.adoption_margin: At least one declared surface and budget must show a traction error factor of at least 2 on all three statistics, or the spline must use at least 25 percent less one-dimensional state at matched traction error on all three statistics.

falsification: If hp-optimized spectral elements erase the accuracy margin, retain the exact native one-space capability and report the measured accuracy and cost split.

prediction_before_results.optimized_sem_effect: The hp envelope is expected to reduce the fixed-degree-six SEM gap substantially and to erase at least one spline traction advantage at N=37 or N=61.
prediction_before_results.coarse_budget: The spline is expected to remain competitive in traction tails at N=19 because P<=12 limits the global high-frequency approximation and low-degree multi-element alternatives spend continuity points.
prediction_before_results.promotion_prediction: Full superiority promotion is not expected to pass across every surface and budget.
prediction_before_results.cost_prediction: SEM is expected to have lower setup cost and reconstruction memory, while the spline may retain competitive recurring evaluation cost after coefficient preparation.

finite_checkpoint: Complete the bounded P=2,...,12 and admissible element-count sweep at N=19,37,61. Repair and rerun invalidated cells once if a comparison defect is found. Do not expand the degree range or surfaces.
